pages.text:
Seven books bound in copper, open on seven stone lecterns: KNOWLEDGE, LAW, INDUSTRY, MEDICINE, FINANCE, FAITH, RECORD.

Each is written in ordinary ink in ordinary hands — Vale, Hawthorne, Blackwood, Whitmore, Ashcroft, Bell, Mercer — and each says, generation after generation, the same thing in its own words: we came down, we counted, we went up.

Every one of them stops on the same line: 17 November 1936. 2:17.
